Questions

What is the median annual wage for Registered nurses in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Registered Nurses in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $97,890.

What is the hourly median for Registered nurses in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Registered Nurses in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $47.06.

How many Registered nurses work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 18,920 wage-and-salary Registered Nurses in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Registered nurses in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.67. Values above 1.00 mean Registered Nurses are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Registered nurses in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Registered Nurses in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $97,610.

How does Austin's Registered nurses median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($97,890) is $2,600 lower than Chicago ($100,490) and $30,370 lower than Seattle ($128,260). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
